lead: Chirag Shetty is a widely followed Indian badminton player, born on 4 July 1997 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, he is 29 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has been recognised with Arjuna Award and national champion.

sections.heading: Chirag Shetty — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists badminton player and Olympic competitor as his occupations.

He has taken part in 2014 Swiss Junior International Badminton Championships – men's doubles, 2014 Belgian Junior International Badminton Championships – men's doubles, badminton at the 2018 Commonwealth Games – men's doubles, badminton at the 2018 Commonwealth Games – mixed team and 2016/2017 Indian Badminton Championships – men's doubles.
